goal: Implement a single-store schedule from native operator draft editing and atomic publication through reliable public today/week viewing, cancellation, rescheduling and withdrawal.
dispatch_precondition: CP3 accepted at exact baseline_commit; clean ownership verified before dispatch.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/gym-miniapp; frozen PRD/matrix/CP4 and technical contract. Complete native operator and public interfaces with actual persistent backend.

Stable course IDs, one private current draft and one public current snapshot. Edit full draft with course revisions; atomic publication CAS both draft and publication, explicit replaceCoverageConfirmed. No fallback to old publication on withdrawal.

Coverage 1-14 configured local days, half-open intervals, explicit covered-empty versus unpublished/outside coverage. Public today/week and current-course summary require no login. Unknown real schedule data stays empty.

Correct cancellation and rescheduling with same course ID; scheduled interval overlap rejects, touching endpoints allowed, cancelled courses excluded from current course/conflict. Cross-day/week and configured IANA timezone conversions validated, including DST missing/repeated local times and explicit offset selection.

Existing transaction/role/audit/idempotency/fresh intent conventions apply; include path target in digest, freeze confirmed versions/form snapshots, handle unknown write results with original operation keys and fresh current-state reads.

Foreground polling and lifecycle: one inflight per resource, hide stops and old callbacks cannot replace current data. Offline/error states explicit, never insert fixture courses or treat no course as empty venue.

Bounded recoverable schedule history cleanup preserves draft/current head/control and current snapshot. Account deletion must scrub any newly added personal links. Preserve prior membership/session/observation semantics and TTL; no additional dependencies without gate.
Local scoped commit authorized; reports/cp4 required, including implementation clarification and per-AC evidence.
out_of_scope: No bookings, capacity, waitlists, attendance, payments, coach profiles, push or real schedule invention. No CP5 tool acceptance or CP6/7 claims.
No deployment/upload/publication, credentials, real user data, frozen product baseline edits or unrelated scope.
acceptance: AC-S01/B01 course: draft invisible, atomic full published snapshot, independent public clients read same revision, no login required.
AC-S02: explicit covered-empty, outside coverage, unpublished and withdrawn remain distinct; never revive old publication or infer venue occupancy.
AC-S03/Z01: stable IDs across cancel/reschedule, one current publication, competing draft/publish CAS, interval overlap validation and deterministic local date/UTC/DST boundaries.
AC-S04: HTTP/business/offline/error states and retry actions correct; unknown writes query original operation then current state; old fixtures never replace unavailable data.

AC-M04/D01/I01/C01 schedule: current server roles and namespace enforced, actual service-process restart persistence, same-key body/target conflicts, bounded cleanup rollback/recovery preserving current snapshot.
Full prior regression, synthetic fixtures, actual native logic tests, exact source hashes and clean scoped commit. Tool/device/real venue layers explicitly unverified.
evidence_required: RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED; reports/cp4 per-AC and layer, source/final commit, file purposes, commands/exit codes/logs, tested source manifest, scope and unverified items.
Independent HTTP clients, real competing processes, publication/withdrawal snapshots, coverage/cancellation/timezone boundary tests, failed transaction and cleanup/restart evidence.
stop_conditions: Only CP4; stop after delivery and await commander acceptance.
If behavior or data boundary must change, stop affected work and report exact product decision; do not silently weaken schedule maintenance or time validation.
